title.zh: 【Arbitrum 推出开发者公会分享链上收入，Offchain Labs 为首个成员】
title.en: 【Arbitrum 推出开发者公会分享链上收入，Offchain Labs 为首个成员】

current_state.zh: Arbitrum Foundation launched an invite-only Arbitrum Developer Guild that channels 2% of net protocol revenue and 3% of priority gas auction and sequencer data-stream income to teams contributing to core technology, with Offchain Labs as the first and currently sole member receiving all funds.
current_state.en: Arbitrum Foundation launched an invite-only Arbitrum Developer Guild that channels 2% of net protocol revenue and 3% of priority gas auction and sequencer data-stream income to teams contributing to core technology, with Offchain Labs as the first and currently sole member receiving all funds.
